title: THE CONVOY AND THE BOUNTY STAY OUT OF THE STRONGHOLDS
why: The machine convoy picks a start and a far end, and the bounty pillager picks where he steps out of the streets. Neither pick looked for the strongholds, though the wave spawner and the clue props already do. In about one pick in twenty-five the convoy started or ended inside a stronghold, or the bounty stepped out inside one, and the fence, which nobody crosses, held the body there for the whole event: the convoy carrier sat against the inside of the fence for 170 seconds and never travelled (even with the gate open), and the bounty never came for the player and slipped away or was killed by the garrison, so nothing could be paid. Proven in headless Chromium on real frames: seed 4246 second event, the convoy started 175 from the centre of a 240 compound and was still there when the event ran out; seed 4249, the bounty stepped out 233 from the centre and stayed inside the whole hunt. The picks now keep clear of every stronghold: the convoy by 100 (its crew forms round it), the bounty by 60.
now: The machine convoy and the bounty pillager no longer start inside a stronghold, where the fence trapped them for the whole event.
